svg.title: Md. Nafiz Ahmed
svg.desc: I build databases, servers and compilers from scratch, and the 3D and multiplayer things that run on top of them. A night sky whose constellation names 9 live projects: Vernissage, Ryōiki Tenkai, Vantage, Logarithm Warehouse, ebru, kirie, Asterism, lumen, gedis.

g.text: I build databases, servers and compilers from scratch,
and the 3D and multiplayer things that run on top of them.
Every star here is a project, running live below.
Go · Rust · TypeScript · C# · Python · C
